outcome: A change request can be logged, assessed, decided and authorised from its work page (part 1 of SCR-31)
acceptance_criteria: `/work/4201` (mock, Next 4990, mock 4991) shows the title, category tag, the five-step track with step 1 current, four impact rows (three recorded, Security "Not given yet" and MISSING) and "Record an assessment" only on the Security row — verify: open page; `e2e/change-request.spec.ts`.

Stage grouping: stages source, impact, authorization all light step 1; notice, execution, go_live, signatures/complete light 2 to 5; an unknown stage lights no step and shows the raw text — verify: unit test on the stage mapper.

Steps 2 to 5 have no button or link that sends a request in any state — verify: e2e asserts no control with those labels; `grep -rn "document_review\|operate_delivery\|\"close\"\|execution\|restart" frontend/src/features/change-request` finds no request code.

The decider list shows exactly the roles in `decisions[]` (fixture `4202` five rows, a Normal client-internal fixture with two rows shows two); the page never shows "all five" text and no row not in the read — verify: unit test per fixture and page.
A decider row shows only the verdict buttons in its `verdicts[]`; an empty list shows none; fixture `4205` shows no write control and no banner — verify: e2e.

Recording an impact assessment sends `POST /work/4201/change` with `action:"assess"`, `expected_revision`, `case_revision`, `change_version_id`, every contract key present, unknown choices as `null`, `effort_person_days` as the typed string, and the page then shows the team as recorded after re-read — verify: unit test on the body builder; e2e checks the request body in the mock log.
An empty effort is `null` and renders "Not recorded"; the page never shows "0" for an unrecorded effort — verify: unit and e2e.

Recording a decision sends `action:"decide"` with `role`, `verdict`, a non-empty `note` and `evidence` id from `evidence[]`; with an empty note the Record button stays disabled and no request is made — verify: unit and e2e.
A return or reject asks for confirmation and a note; cancelling sends nothing — verify: e2e.

After a `reject` (fixture `4203`) the page shows REJECTED, the reject note and who recorded it only if the read carries it, and "You can log a new change later"; no authorise control — verify: e2e on `4203` against the rejected board.

`/work/4204` shows "Record the authorisation" with a choice from `authorization_choices[]` (or none when empty), a confirm step, and sends `{action:"authorize", ..., commercial}` once; the Authorised by, Authorised on and proof fields from the board are not drawn — verify: e2e and body assertion; DOM has no "Authorised by" input.

`can_authorize:false` or a non-null `authorization_id` shows no authorise control; the authorised state shows "Authorised" and whatever `authorization_id` allows, no person or time — verify: e2e on fixtures.
`deployment_authorized` is false in every state and the page never says deployment is authorised — verify: unit test on the mapper; grep copy.

A 409 on any write keeps the typed text, shows "This change was updated by someone else. Reload to see it.", and sends nothing automatically; Reload re-reads and keeps the typed note where the field still exists — verify: mock scenario `conflict`; unit.

A 422 with `fields[]` shows each message by its field; a 403 `csrf_failed` refreshes the session and says "Press save again" without resending; 413, 415 and 429 show their wording — verify: mock scenarios; fetch counts in unit tests.

A dropped network or 5xx on a write shows "We could not confirm this was saved" with "Check again" only; Check again re-reads and never resends; double click on submit sends one request — verify: unit with fake fetch counting calls.
A re-read after 201 failing leaves the form locked with "Couldn't refresh" and Try again, not a repeat of the write — verify: unit.
`/work/4206` and a live work id the caller cannot see both show exactly "This record is unavailable." — verify: open both; unit on the 404 body.

The change list for a project shows each record's reference, category tag (Standard or Normal), module and description from `ordinary-changes`; an empty list shows "No changes logged yet" — verify: e2e and live curl comparison of the same project.

Log a change sends `capture` with reference, category, module, description, reason, `evidence_id` and `case_revision`; every field is required before the button enables; the `evidence_id` can only be chosen from the read's `evidence[]`; a 201 refreshes the list with the new row and a 409 keeps the typed text — verify: unit and e2e.

For a Standard change with catalogue entries, `preapprove` and `bind_standard` send the contract bodies with `key` chosen from `catalogue[]`; with `catalogue_finding` non-empty the Standard path is disabled and the finding is shown (fixtures `4207`, `4208`) — verify: e2e; there is no free-text key input.

A control that needs an `evidence` id and has an empty `evidence[]` is disabled with "No proof file is recorded for this case yet"; no write is sent without an evidence id — verify: e2e with a fixture whose `evidence` is empty.

Against live Django 8030 (Postgres, `live-lead`), `GET /work/{id}/change` for a `pmo-change/v1` item renders reference, impact and deciders matching the JSON from curl; one `assess` or `decide` on a test change returns 201 and the page re-read shows it — verify: compare page and curl; record the response.

Revision handling: the work `expected_revision` and `case_revision` in every body equal the last read; after a 201 the next write uses a freshly read pair, never the old one — verify: unit test sequence.
A `null` or absent optional field renders "Not recorded"/omitted, never 0; a `summary` null impact row shows "Not given yet" — verify: unit on the mapper.

The agent card, "Recorded by PM · date", person names on deciders, "Authorised by" and any "milestone scope now includes" line are not drawn and leave no empty gap — verify: e2e DOM absent; screenshots.

Layout at 1440 and 390 matches the part 1 boards (default, impact, decision, rejected, authorise) for the parts that remain, with the keyboard and focus order working on the forms and confirm steps — verify: screenshots at both widths against the 10 boards; Tab through each form.
The shared frame is unchanged: `git diff origin/main -- frontend/src/features/workspace` is empty — verify: that command.

New unit tests cover the stage mapper, status tag, assess/decide/authorize/capture body builders, null handling and the write error mapper; `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` pass — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: High. `authorize` commits a commercial and scope decision, and `decide` and `assess` feed it. Both are role-gated (`can_authorize`, `roles[]`) and revision-gated, and they are hard to undo. The part 2 notice would be an external client message and `close` records signatures. Those stay out of this PR. SURFACES are ui, api, auth (role-gated actions) and product-decision (authorising a change). It is a new flow, so product acceptance is required. The merge goes to the design engineer's batch, not the D-180/D-184 routine route.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
